home.footer: Unofficial fan app. You need your own copy of Sail.
home.title: Play Sail solo.
home.lead: The Bosun takes the other side of the ship. You flip its cards; the app keeps the tricks, the Kraken and the storms.
home.how1: Set up Sail as usual and pick a difficulty.
home.how2: Each trick, the app tells you how the Bosun plays.
home.how3: Tap the winner and the symbols: you get the order.

newVoyage.title: NEW VOYAGE
newVoyage.seatHint: So the app’s arrows point the way your ship sails.
newVoyage.easyDesc: Two Pirate cards, shared. Whoever wins the trick may use either.
newVoyage.mediumDesc: One Pirate card each. The winner may use their own.
newVoyage.hardDesc: Only you have a Pirate card. The Bosun has none.
newVoyage.cw: The Bosun has the Cannon + Wheel pirate
newVoyage.cwHint: The app walks you through its card swap.
newVoyage.hardNote: On Hard the Bosun has no Pirate card.

setup.title: SET UP THE TABLE
setup.sub: {scenario} · {difficulty, select, easy {Easy} medium {Medium} other {Hard}} · tick each line as you do it
setup.line1: Assemble the ocean board. Put the play area and Kraken boards at opposite ends.
setup.line3: {pirates, select, easy {Pirate cards: two, shared, beside the board.} easyCw {Pirate cards: two, shared, beside the board; one is the Cannon + Wheel.} mediumCw {Pirate cards: one for you, the Cannon + Wheel for the Bosun.} hard {Pirate card: one for you. The Bosun has none.} other {Pirate cards: one for you, one for the Bosun.}}
setup.line4: Kraken on its lowest left space, the 3. Trick cubes on 0.
setup.line5: Round disc on I, on your side: you lead the first trick.
setup.line7: Kraken deck: the six 1s and 2s shuffled, face up, the Kraken card at the bottom.
setup.line8: Player deck: the 3s to 9s shuffled, face down.
setup.line9: Deal 9 cards to yourself and 9 face down to the Bosun’s stack. Don’t look at its cards.
setup.noteAll: Tick all {n} lines to set sail
setup.note: {n, plural, one {Tick the last line to set sail} other {Tick the # lines left to set sail}}
